component.name: Proton Inspector
component.summary: Scan and edit numeric values in Linux and Proton game processes

description.p: A Linux desktop memory scanner with combined numeric searches, value editing, freezing and saved address lists.

This Flatpak is a host launcher. It uses host-command permission to run its bundled application outside the sandbox so it can inspect game processes. The scanner has your normal user privileges; it does not run as root or change Linux memory-access policies.
Experimental x86-64 package. Absolute saved addresses may change after restarting a game.
